subject: Request: Geo-failover playbook exhibits + RTO/RPO artifacts
messages:
From: Sandra Lopez <s.lopez@acmepayments.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Walters <tom.walters@fincloud.io>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Geo-failover playbook exhibits + RTO/RPO artifacts

Hi Marcus,

We're preparing materials for our external SOC 2 auditor next week and need to include technical exhibits that demonstrate multi-region continuity and measured RTO/RPO. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday if possible?

- An excerpt of the geo-failover/playbook (steps for region cutover and health checks)
- Recent failover execution logs or a summary of the last production failover test (with timestamps)
- A signed RTO/RPO attestation (or pointer to the attestation in your compliance pack)
- Measured warm-cache/KV restore timings and any notes on cache-warming strategy

We're mainly focused on the customer-observable impact (latency and data availability) and the controls that prove your practice is repeatable. If some items are narrow or redacted that's fine — the auditor just needs enough to verify the control.

Thanks,
Sandra
Sandra Lopez
Head of Vendor Risk, Acme Payments

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Lopez <s.lopez@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Geo-failover playbook exhibits + RTO/RPO artifacts

Hi Sandra — thanks for the clear list. We're able to provide the artifacts you requested; attaching a package with a short cover note and the primary exhibits. High level:

- Attached: "redwood_geo_failover_playbook_v1.pdf" — playbook excerpt that includes failover decision tree, runbook steps, smoke-checks, DNS/traffic routing notes, and rollback criteria.
- Attached: "failover-execution-log_20270312.csv" — anonymized execution log from our last rehearsed failover (timestamps, phase markers, outcome).
- Attached: "rto_rpo_attestation_2027-03-18.pdf" — signed attestation from our Head of Ops. RTO target for customer-facing reads is 15 minutes for region failover; RPO is tested at sub-1s for persisted state and under 60s for in-flight KV sync depending on workload class (we document class mapping in playbook).
- Attached: "kv-warm-cache-timings-aggregated.csv" — aggregated warm-cache rebuild timings from the last three rehearsals across two regions; see summary table on page 2 of the playbook.

We've redacted IP-level topology and alarm thresholds from the public playbook excerpt; auditors typically accept that. If the auditor needs an unredacted view under an NDA, we can arrange a controlled session.

Logistics: Grace will drop a short summary memo and the CSVs into a shared Drive link (included below). If you need DocuSign on the attestation, Evelyn can sign the final envelope this afternoon.

Next steps: Please confirm if the redactions are okay or if you need anything unredacted for the auditor.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
